sequence.concept: Integrate climate, soil, water, biodiversity and microbial mechanisms with quantitative environmental evidence, life-cycle and circular-resource analysis, energy solutions and sustainability governance. Actual microbial culture and molecular laboratory methods strengthen the natural-science response. This is a broader response to the confirmed common academic core; the specialisation and individual thesis pathway are unassessed.
sequence.label: Environmental systems, circular solutions & governance

sequence.concept: Study ecosystem condition and resilience through actual biodiversity, conservation, evolutionary and biological mechanisms, coupled with soil/water science, environmental chemistry, remediation and land-use effects. This is a related response to the confirmed common core, not a complete external specialisation or thesis pathway.
sequence.label: Ecosystems, soil & environmental resilience

sequence.concept: Study how institutions, markets, collective choices and behaviour shape environmental responses. Join actual policy/economic methods, qualitative/quantitative evidence and sustainability communication to a concrete environmental-science and resource/water foundation. This is a related response to the confirmed common core, not a complete external specialisation or thesis pathway.
sequence.label: Environmental policy, economics & evidence
